You can add more Google Workspace emails on the same domain:

1. Go to **Business Email** in your Wix account.
2. Scroll to the business email for that domain and click **Add Users**.
3. Choose how many additional emails you want from the drop-down.
4. Select your saved payment method (or **Use Another Card**).
5. Click **Submit Purchase**. Your bank may ask you to verify your identity.

Then set up the new addresses in the **Users** section of the Google Workspace Admin console.

Good to know: you can have up to **300** business emails, buying up to **20 per transaction**.

Use a Wix form with a **custom price** (pay-what-you-want) option. First make sure your site is upgraded and connected to a payment method.

**New Wix Forms:**
1. Add a form (**Add Elements → Contact & Forms**) and click **Edit Form**.
2. Under **Transaction fields**, choose **Custom price**.
3. Set the **minimum amount**, and optionally enable a **maximum amount**.

**Old Wix Forms:**
1. Click the form → **Form Settings → Payment → Get Started → Next**.
2. Select **Visitors Enter Price** and click **Next**.
3. Enter the item name, a **default price** to suggest, and the **minimum and maximum** under Price Range.

For donations, you can also use the **Donation** field and enable **Allow custom amount**. After submitting, visitors go to checkout to pay.

If your slider is a **Wix Pro Gallery**, the animation you choose applies to every image in it:

1. Click the gallery in your editor → **Settings**.
2. Click the **Design** tab → **Scroll Animations**.
3. Pick an effect (e.g. Fade in, Slide up, Expand, Zoom out).
4. To fine-tune: click **Customize Animations** and set the **transition style** and **duration** (available for horizontal-scroll layouts).

Note: in the **Slideshow** and **Thumbnails** layouts, only the **Scroll, Fade** and **Stack** slide animations are available. Preview your site to see the animation.

Set the file's sharing to **Anyone with the link**:

1. In Google Drive, select the file and click **Share**.
2. Under **General access** (or **Get Link**), click the drop-down and choose **Anyone with the link**.
3. Choose what people can do: **Viewer**, **Commenter** or **Editor**. Viewer is safest.
4. Click **Copy link** (or **Done**).

If you're showing it with the **Google Drive app** on your site, you can also click **Change to Public** when selecting the file. Note that making a **folder** public also exposes all files inside it.

To edit your store's Cart page:

1. In the editor, click **Pages & Menu** → **Store Pages** → **Cart Page**.
2. Click the **Cart Page** element, then **Settings**.
3. Choose what to change:
   - **Settings tab:** what's shown, e.g. shipping rates, the promo code link, the "Add a note" link.
   - **Design tab:** background, borders, fonts, colors and buttons.
   - **Text:** edit the page's text.

**Mobile:** switch to the mobile editor, click the Cart Page → **Settings** to choose where the checkout button appears.

Tip: to see how the cart looks with items, click **Preview**, go to your shop and add a product to the cart.

You can switch to another plan of the same duration anytime:

1. Go to **Premium Subscriptions** in your Wix account.
2. Click the **More Actions** icon next to the plan.
3. Click **Change Plan**.
4. Select the new plan and follow the on-screen steps.

**To change monthly ↔ yearly:** use **More Actions → Change Billing Cycle** instead. Longer cycles take effect immediately (with credit for remaining time); shorter ones start when the current cycle ends.

If **Change Plan** doesn't appear (e.g. the plan was transferred from another account), there's a workaround: cancel the old plan's auto-renewal, duplicate the site, move the old plan to the duplicate, upgrade the original site to the new plan, and reassign your domain. I can connect you with an agent if you need help with that.

Since your domain uses Wix name servers, you add MX records in your Wix account:

1. Go to **Domains** in your Wix account.
2. Click the **Domain Actions** icon next to the domain → **Edit MX Records**.
3. Check the drop-down:
   - **Provider listed:** select it and click **Start Connecting**. That's it.
   - **Not listed:** choose **Other (provider not on the list)**.
4. Click the **Points to** field and enter the mail server address. For more records, click **+ Add Another**. Add the record with the **lowest priority value first**.
5. Click **Connect Business Email**.

If your email provider also needs other records (e.g. TXT, CNAME), go to **Manage DNS Records**, click **+ Add Record** under that type, enter it and click **Save**.
